author: CNET
description:
Google's Gemini multimodal AI is available for MacOS and Windows. CNET's Stephen Beacham demonstrates how to download and install it on a Mac, and walks you through every button and feature in the app. 

Read more about the Gemini App for MacOS on CNET.com
MacOS Now Has a Native Gemini AI App https://zdcs.link/a0MZb5

Gemini for MacOS Gets New Voice and ‘Screen Awareness’ Features https://zdcs.link/Qr5l0P
